key.name: position
key.description: Banner in Quick Settings (top/bottom, attached or detached), or standalone panel button that opens the image on its own

key.name: images
key.description: Image file paths. One is the default image, the rest are shown on hover when hover gallery is on

key.name: default-image
key.description: Path of the default image. If empty or not in the list, the first image is used

key.name: hover-images-enabled
key.description: Moving the mouse across the banner switches between the images

key.name: image-width
key.description: Width of the image in pixels (-1 = full width: Quick Settings width, or screen width in standalone mode)

key.name: image-height
key.description: Height of the banner in pixels

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels for the image and the banner frame (0 = square)

key.name: fill-mode
key.description: What fills the banner where the image does not cover it: a plain color, or a blurred copy of the image itself

key.name: fill-color
key.description: CSS color shown behind the image where it does not cover the banner. Empty = theme default

key.name: border-color
key.description: CSS color of the banner border. Empty = soft white

key.name: border-width
key.description: Border thickness in pixels (0 = no border)

key.name: gap
key.description: Gap in pixels between the banner and the Quick Settings grid

key.name: quick-settings-width
key.description: Width of the Quick Settings menu in pixels (0 = default)

key.name: panel-button-icon
key.description: Icon name or full path to an image file (standalone mode)

key.name: panel-button-position
key.description: Which side of the top panel the standalone button goes to

key.name: standalone-gap
key.description: Gap in pixels between the top bar and the image in standalone mode

key.name: script-path
key.description: Path to script that executes when image is clicked
